example.title: Pearson's Port: floating live fish and crab market on a harbour dock

brief: A floating fish market in the harbour (run by one family since the early 1970s): a low single-storey timber shed on a pontoon deck, its flat tar-paper roof carrying a painted billboard ('LIVE CRAB · FISH · LOBSTER'), a cupola-like ventilator box, board-and-batten walls with serving hatches, live tanks and crab pots along a railed timber walkway that ties it to the shore, dinghies moored alongside, kayakers passing. One aerial photo. Mooring piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
